title: Extracellular DNA Extraction from Sediment Using NucleoSpin® Soil Kit
author: Cecile Chardon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.betsjene

steps.title: Label and weigh tubes
steps.instruction: Annotate one 2 mL tube per sample, weigh each empty tube on a scale with 0.0001 g precision and record tube name and weight in the notebook.

steps.title: Transfer sediment to tubes
steps.instruction: Homogenize sediment with a sterilized spatula, ensure it is fully thawed, then transfer approximately 0.5 g of sediment into the annotated tube using the appropriate method (spatula for compact sediment or a cut 1000 µL tip for watery sediment). Record the method and any comments, weigh the tube containing sediment, mark a cross on the storage tube, store at –40 °C or –80 °C, and note the storage location.

steps.title: Add phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Add saturated phosphate buffer (0.12 M Na₂HPO₄, pH ≈ 8, stored <1 week at +4 °C) in a volume equal to the sediment weight (e.g., 0.5 mL for 0.5 g sediment). Close the cap and seal with parafilm if desired.

steps.title: Agitate sediment suspension
steps.instruction: Attach the tubes to an agitator, rotate at slow speed at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 10 000 rpm for 10 minutes (temperature not specified). Transfer the clear supernatant to a new 2 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Inhibitor removal filtration
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Inhibitor Removal Column (red ring) in a 2 mL collection tube, load up to 650 µL of supernatant onto the column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 1 minute, and repeat loading and centrifugation until all supernatant is filtered. Collect all filtrate in a single clean tube, discard the column, and if a pellet appears after centrifugation, transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube before continuing.

steps.title: Add buffer SB
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of buffer SB, close the lid, vortex for 5 seconds, then perform a brief centrifugation.

steps.title: Load sample onto Soil column
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® Soil Column (green ring) in a 2 mL collection tube, load 550 µL of the sample onto the column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, return the column to the tube, load the remaining sample, centrifuge again for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of buffer SB to the Soil Column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the collection tube.

steps.title: Second wash
steps.instruction: Add 550 µL of buffer SW1 to the Soil Column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the collection tube.

steps.title: Third wash
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL of buffer SW2 (verify ethanol was added during first use) to the Soil Column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the collection tube.

steps.title: Fourth wash
steps.instruction: Add another 650 µL of buffer SW2 to the Soil Column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the collection tube.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collection tube at 11 000 × g for 2 minutes. If any liquid contacts the Soil Column after this step, discard the flow‑through and repeat the centrifugation.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the Soil Column into a new microcentrifuge tube (not provided), add 30 µL of buffer SE (optionally pre‑heat to 50 °C to increase yield), leave the lid open and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute 30 seconds, close the lid and centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard the column, keep the tube containing the eluate, and store DNA frozen at –20 °C (or –40 °C to –80 °C for long‑term storage) until library preparation.

steps.title: Final buffer SL3 treatment
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of buffer SL3, vortex for 5 seconds, incubate at 4 °C for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 1 minute.
